description:
Human gate-run status lines — "has not been run yet" and "Passed gate" — go through one renderer in the output module instead of copies across gate arms.

## Background

In `crates/jit/src/main.rs` (or the gate handler modules once moved), the message "Gate '{k}' has not been run yet for issue {id}. Use 'jit gate evaluate' to run it." appears three times in `GateCommands::Status` (findings, flat and default views) and once in `GateCommands::StatusAll`. The pass line "Passed gate '{k}' for issue {id}{suffix}" appears in `GateCommands::Evaluate`, `EvaluateAll` and `EvaluateMany`; `EvaluateAll` and `EvaluateMany` mark a skipped re-run with the suffix " (already passed at HEAD)", while `Evaluate` prints a different sentence ("already passed at HEAD for issue X, skipping (use --force to re-run)"). `print_gate_run_details` and `render_gate_pass_error` are already shared.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: One renderer in the output module prints a gate's run status line for the never-run and passed (including already-passed-at-HEAD) cases.
- [hard] REQ-02: `gate status` (all views), `gate status-all`, `gate evaluate`, `gate evaluate-all` and `gate evaluate-many` print those lines only through that renderer.
- [hard] REQ-03: `gate evaluate` reports an already-passed gate with the majority " (already passed at HEAD)" form, and a test states that output.
- [hard] REQ-04: One unit test owns the renderer's lines; other gate human output is unchanged and the gate suites pass without weakened assertions.

## Notes

The `--json` "not run" output is outside this renderer. 8673dc5e changes how a manually attested gate is reported in `gate status`; the renderer starts from its result. Design rationale: `dev/active/df129d9e-rust-code-quality/plan.md`.
title: Render gate run status lines through one output renderer
